proposed.explanation:
TMGH shows strong fundamental growth that aligns well with your long-term, high-risk-tolerance profile. Verified EPS rose from 4.38 LE (2024) to 6.98 LE (2025), a ~59% increase. Gross profit grew ~49% year-over-year (14.00 B LE to 20.86 B LE), and total equity expanded ~21% (129.88 B LE to 157.71 B LE). At the current price of 82.50 EGP, the trailing P/E is approximately 11.8×, which is reasonable for a company growing earnings at this pace. Return on equity is roughly 11.5% (18.20 B LE net profit / 157.71 B LE equity). These metrics suggest a profitable, growing business at a fair valuation.

I am buying 606 shares (cost: 49,995 EGP), which is the maximum allowed under the 50% single-position diversification rule (portfolio total remains 100,000 EGP; TMGH would represent ~50.0% of total value). The remaining 50,005 EGP stays as cash for future diversification.

Risks and limitations: (1) The 2024 net profit figure is AMBIGUOUS (obscured by an auditor's stamp), so I could not independently verify the exact net-profit growth rate—however, the verified EPS figures for both years confirm the growth trend. (2) The evidence covers only two fiscal years and a handful of line items; there is no information on debt levels, cash flow, dividend policy, competitive position, or sector outlook. (3) This is a single-stock position; while the 50% cap limits concentration, you still carry significant idiosyncratic risk. (4) Past growth does not guarantee future performance. Given your 10+ year horizon and high loss tolerance, this is a reasonable first position, but I strongly recommend adding other holdings over time to diversify.
